gloss: in order; one by one; in sequence

definitions.gloss: in order; one by one; in sequence; in turn
definitions.explanation: Following a set order or sequence, dealing with things one at a time from first to last.

examples.japanese: {順|じゅん}に{並|なら}んでください。
{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ぶ。
examples.english: To call names in numerical order.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つずつ{順|じゅん}に{説明|せつめい}しますので、{質問|しつもん}は{最後|さいご}にお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'll explain things one by one in order, so please save questions for the end.

notes:
The noun {順|じゅん} (order/sequence) combined with the particle に to function as an adverb meaning 'in order.' Extremely common in daily life, from queuing to following instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順|じゅん}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in order
- {順|じゅん}に{呼|よ}ぶ: to call in order
- {順|じゅん}に{説明|せつめい}する: to explain in order
- {上|うえ}から{順|じゅん}に: from the top, in order
- {大|おお}きい{順|じゅん}に: in order from largest

USAGE:
Often combined with a criterion: {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に (in numerical order), {年齢|ねんれい}{順|じゅん}に (in order of age), {到着|とうちゃく}{順|じゅん}に (in order of arrival). The criterion + {順|じゅん}に pattern is very productive.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}に: in turn — emphasizes taking turns among people
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に: one after another — emphasizes the sequential, continuing nature
- {次々|つぎつぎ}に: one after another — faster pace; less about order, more about rapid succession
